messages.subject: Two legends in qplot
parts:
I tried to make a qplot of multiple lines with the following code:
qplot(t, value, fill=variable, data=dat, geom="line", colour=variable,
ylab=NULL, xlab=NULL)
+ scale_colour_hue(name="Method",legend=T )
I then got 2 legend plates, one is with title "variable", the other is
"Method". And the "Method" one has the different color lines but not
the variable one. I have also tried using
scale_fill_discrete("Method"). There were still two legends but the
"Method" one did not have the lines (worse case I think).

Can anyone show me how to get rid of the variable legend plate and
only leave with one plate which is the "Method"?

Thanks!
